title: Design: LRU Cache (O(1))
hints: O(1) needs a dictionary for lookup plus a doubly linked list for recency.
Use sentinel head and tail nodes; move a node to the front on each access and evict `tail.prev` when over capacity.
`unlink(n); pushFront(n)` on hits; on overflow: `let lru = tail.prev!; unlink(lru); map[lru.key] = nil`.
